status: frozen prospective design; not executed; approval required

measurement.context_smoke: one direct and one gateway 32K request per profile, separately labeled and inside the 36-request cap; failures/timeouts retained

boundaries.client: HTTP dispatch to first nonempty emission, and to EOF, measured by the existing capture runner
boundaries.runtime: final response request-lifecycle metrics only; native execution counters reported separately
boundaries.admin_enabled: monitor on; direct inference remains direct to runtime
boundaries.gateway: actual authenticated gateway public route, recorded separately, never pooled with direct samples
boundaries.ingestion_overhead: Isolated ingestion on/off is unassessed without a separately reviewed recording-only toggle; the monitor-off condition compares whole-admin overhead and cannot be relabeled ingestion-only overhead.
boundaries.monitor_off_method: After owned readiness, stop the admin service only; the independently owned Splash runtime remains alive. This measures whole-admin overhead, not isolated ingestion. Exact commands need live worksheet approval.

review_thresholds.minimum_samples_note: Three repeats are a bounded integration diagnostic, not a new statistical/adoption pass. Compare only identical boundaries/conditions; retained frozen Phase 0 results remain unchanged.
review_thresholds.quality: required functional/32K and gateway checks; reasoning-off remains unqualified
review_thresholds.memory: no pressure escalation or sidecar residency; stock reclamation remains inconclusive

accounting: Keep failed/partial/cancelled/unassessed attempts; missing usage remains null. Never infer rates from chunks; stop before request/time cap and reserve restoration time.
